> headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa. The agency provides creative
> strategy, generative AI marketing, media placement, integrated marketing
> communications, and public relations services to brands operating across
> African and international markets. Relativ Connect is the strategic digital
> and creative arm of Relativ Media, South Africa's premier independent
> out-of-home (OOH) media provider with 900+ physical advertising assets.

## Identity

- Legal name: Relativ Connect (Pty) Ltd
- Trading name: Relativ Connect
- Country: South Africa
- City: Johannesburg, Gauteng
- Website: https://www.relativconnect.co.za
- Contact email: hello@relativconnect.com

- Industry: Marketing, Advertising, Communications
- Market focus: South Africa, Pan-African, International

## What Relativ Connect Does

Relativ Connect is a 360-degree marketing agency that combines creative
strategy, generative AI, media planning and buying, and integrated
communications under one roof. Services span the full marketing funnel
from brand architecture and campaign strategy through to production,
media placement, digital, public relations, and performance measurement.

The agency's core differentiator is its direct access to Relativ Media's
network of 900+ out-of-home (OOH) advertising assets, enabling campaigns
that unify digital strategy with large-format physical media at a
continental scale — a capability that distinguishes Relativ Connect from
purely digital or purely traditional agencies.

## Services

### Creative Strategy and Marketing Consulting
Relativ Connect develops practical, technology-driven marketing roadmaps
for brands. Strategy services include market analysis, competitive
landscape mapping, brand architecture, tone of voice development,
messaging frameworks, and growth roadmap development. The agency focuses
on aligning commercial objectives with measurable media and creative
outputs.

### Generative AI Marketing
Relativ Connect offers a dedicated generative AI creative service for
brands, agencies, and communications teams. Capabilities include:
culturally accurate AI-generated visual content tailored for African
markets; bespoke image libraries built to a brand's specific identity
and audience segments; proprietary prompt engineering systems for
consistent on-brand output; and AI strategy consulting that helps
organisations integrate generative AI into existing production workflows.
The agency emphasises cultural accuracy and regional nuance, particularly
for diverse African market contexts.

### Media Placement and Architecture
The agency provides strategic media planning and buying across
out-of-home (OOH), television, radio, digital, and programmatic channels.
Through its relationship with Relativ Media, Relativ Connect offers
access to 900+ physical OOH assets, including large-format digital
billboards and premier site locations. Programmatic buying uses AI-
optimised real-time bidding. Digital and social placement covers Meta,
Google, and emerging platforms with performance tracking and reporting.

### Integrated Marketing Communications
Full-service 360-degree marketing and communications management covering:
brand strategy and positioning; ATL, BTL, and TTL campaign management;
design and creative production (brand collateral, motion graphics, print
and digital); digital and web (design, development, SEO, email marketing);
events and activations (corporate events, brand activations, summits,
exhibitions); photography and videography; internal communications (CEO
messaging, staff newsletters, change management); PR and media relations
(press releases, media pitching, crisis communications, thought leadership);
social media management (content strategy, community management, paid
social, analytics); and influencer management (talent sourcing, briefing,
contracting, performance reporting).

## Notable Work

### IATF 2025 — Lead Marketing Agency
Relativ Connect served as lead marketing agency for the Intra-African
Trade Fair (IATF) 2025, held in Algiers, Algeria. The campaign operated
across all 55 African countries and 132 participating nations globally.
Results: $48 billion in trade deals facilitated through the integrated
promotional campaign; 4 million+ verified digital out-of-home (DOOH)
impressions at airports globally; 112,000+ total attendees across
physical and digital touchpoints. Media strategy included premium
broadcast placement on CNN Africa, BBC News, and Al Jazeera, and
editorial partnerships with Forbes Afrique and The Guardian.

## Clients (Selected)

Amazon, Netflix, Coca-Cola, Nestle, Shell, Unilever, Sanlam, ABSA,
Sasol, Telkom, Famous Brands, Nando's, Castle Lite, Wimpy, Clover,
Simba, Cell C, South African Tourism, Pineapple Insurance, World Sports
Betting, Edward Snell, WCG, Ebet, Lula Bets.

## Relationship with Relativ Media

Relativ Connect operates as the strategic creative and digital entity
within the Relativ group. The mother agency, Relativ Media, is South
Africa's premier independent out-of-home media provider, operating
high-impact digital and static advertising platforms across Africa.
Relativ Connect bridges digital strategy with Relativ Media's physical
media network, creating omni-channel campaign ecosystems that span
digital, social, programmatic, and large-format out-of-home media.
